name: The Fate of the Kingdom
label: Quest
description: The Fate of the Kingdom: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: It would seem as if my old adversary, Dagran Thaurissan, has me and the kingdom of Ironforge at his mercy.
You may be my last hope, friend. You must rescue my dear daughter, Moira!
There is only one way to make sure that the spell Thaurissan has cast on Moira is broken: Kill him.
And friend, do not harm her! Remember, she is being controlled by Thaurissan! The things she may do or say are a result of Thaurissan's evil spell!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Princess Bronzebeard weeps over the loss of Emperor Dagran Thaurissan.
